title: Native renderer exact submission caches
scope: Two localhost Chromium processes sharing one host. 960x720 picture; every forward frame/effect retained. Dirty replica is diagnostic. CPU sampling is not GPU timing; captured frames are not physical scanout or input-to-photon.

experimentNotes.b1: Word comparison and inactive uniforms only; inconclusive under variable host load
experimentNotes.b2: Retained combination adds exact context reuse and persistent shader-variant map
experimentNotes.a3: Final return to reference paths; same sources as B2, drawopt=0
